records.processing: Derivative of the official Steam promotional asset: embedded Phantom Blade Zero title lettering was removed with AI-assisted image editing. The production derivative was resized without crop to 1400 by 800 and re-encoded as a progressive JPEG with mozjpeg quality 90 and 4:4:4 chroma; no claim is made that it is an untouched original or that S-GAME/PARAWULIN authorized the modification.

records.processing: Non-generative Weapon Master derivative of the owner-supplied 1440 by 3200 JPEG. Extracted source region left=0, top=1100, width=720, height=1080 to exclude phone chrome, game menu, right-side skill text, button prompts, and page indicator while retaining both visible weapons. Resized that region to 1040 by 1560 and composited it at left=80, top=120 on a 1200 by 1800 dark neutral canvas. Re-encoded as a progressive JPEG with sharp quality 88 and 4:4:4 chroma. No generative editing, UI inpainting, repainting, or weapon reconstruction was performed.

records.processing: Non-generative Weapon Master derivative of the owner-supplied 1440 by 3200 JPEG. Extracted source region left=0, top=1140, width=720, height=1080 to exclude phone chrome, game menu, right-side skill text, button prompts, and page indicator while retaining the visible weapon. Resized that region to 1040 by 1560 and composited it at left=80, top=120 on a 1200 by 1800 dark neutral canvas. The original screenshot ends before the lower blade is fully visible, and that source-truncated state is retained without reconstruction. Re-encoded as a progressive JPEG with sharp quality 88 and 4:4:4 chroma. No generative editing, UI inpainting, repainting, or weapon reconstruction was performed.
